cycles.pick: Strict auth rate limit (10/10min) + trust proxy
cycles.why: Login had only the 100/min global limiter; OWASP + 2026 consensus is 5-10 tries per 5-15min on auth routes. Highest impact/effort ratio.
research: CVE-2026-30827 (noted; we use custom keyed limiter, no subnet masking)
changes: rateLimit.ts: createRateLimiter factory, authLimiter 10/10min, test reset hook
app.ts: trust proxy=1, authLimiter on /api/auth
tests: 429-after-11-attempts

cycles.why: Old Dockerfiles ran --workspace installs with no root package.json and missed packages/config for tsc extends; images could never build.
changes: Dockerfile.api/web rewritten: copy root+workspace package.jsons, npm ci, build, slim prod runner (api runs as non-root node)
.dockerignore hardened (nested node_modules/dist, .git, coverage, .env)
cycles.validate: docker daemon blocked (socket perms); validated by faithful staging: npm ci + workspace build OK, runner npm ci --omit=dev OK, booted dist serves /health + real login + /stats

cycles.pick: Fix CI (root npm ci, per-workspace gates)
cycles.why: CI ran npm ci --workspace (unsupported pattern) twice and never tested shared/ui-kit or typechecks; red CI erodes trust.
changes: ci.yml split into api/web/shared jobs with setup-node npm cache
single root npm ci then workspace build/test/typecheck gates
added typecheck script to ui-kit
cycles.validate: YAML parsed; every CI command executed locally green (api 10/10, shared 3/3, web build, all typechecks)

cycles.why: Dashboard showed hardcoded numbers (48/wk, 9, 132) and fake activity — a number with no context is trivia; failures must never render as stale values.
changes: Dashboard fetches /stats + /tasks + /notifications when authed; preview badge + sign-in CTA otherwise
explicit loading/error-with-retry states
status distribution bars + relative timestamps

cycles.pick: Functional global search (?q= deep links + Cmd+K)
cycles.why: Topbar search was a decorative placeholder; research says search must be instant, shareable via URL, one keystroke away.
changes: Topbar: controlled input, Enter navigates to /kanban?q=, Cmd/Ctrl+K focuses (guarded while typing)
Kanban: filter is the URL ?q= param (shareable, back-button safe)

cycles.why: Side effect during render + full-page reloads break SPA state and StrictMode safety.
changes: <Navigate replace> for authed users, useNavigate after login
aria-labels + role=alert on error

cycles.why: Any render crash blanked the whole app with no recovery path.
changes: ErrorBoundary with retry + dashboard escape, wrapping Routes
Full paths, Task schema, bearer security, servers

cycles.why: No mechanism kept deps fresh; stale deps are the top CVE vector.
changes: dependabot.yml weekly for npm, actions, docker
cycles.validate: YAML parsed; npm audit high+ clean

cycles.pick: Clear npm audit (1 critical + 1 high + 3 moderate)
cycles.why: Bugs beat features; audit found RCE/dev-server CVEs via vitest 2 chain.
changes: vitest ^2.1.8 -> ^4.1.11 (api, shared)
web vite pin corrected to ^6.4.3 (was stale ^5.4.21 lie)
npm dedupe collapsed nested vite 5.4.21/esbuild 0.21.5 -> single vite 6.4.3
rejected plugin-react 6 (needs vite 8, too big for this cycle)
cycles.validate: npm audit 0 across all severities; api 10/10, shared 3/3, web build+typecheck green

cycles.why: Keyboard/SR users had no skip link, no landmarks, no current-page announcement, weak focus visibility.
changes: Skip-to-content link + #main-content landmark
aria-current=page on active nav
global :focus-visible ring

cycles.why: OWASP A09/CWE-778: auth failures are high-value forensic events; we logged nothing.
changes: console.warn structured line: event/email-sanitized/ip/UTC-at on 401
never logs passwords; strips CR/LF (log injection)

cycles.why: Express production best practice: compress response bodies to cut transfer size.
changes: compression@1.8.2 + @types, app.use(compression()) early in chain
cycles.validate: api build + 10/10 tests green; npm audit still 0 across all severities

cycles.why: SPA route changes stranded keyboard/SR users on stale links with no announcement (React Router handles nothing by default).
changes: RouteFocus: focuses view h1 on pathname change, #main-content fallback
main is programmatically focusable (tabIndex -1)

cycles.why: Topbar search only covered tasks; power users need one-keystroke nav + actions.
changes: CommandPalette: pages + live task results, arrows/Enter/Esc, combobox aria, focus restore
Topbar search rebound to / key

cycles.why: No browser-level safety net; unit tests cannot catch routing/render/integration breaks.
changes: e2e workspace: playwright config (dual webServers), 4 smoke specs
CI e2e job (chromium + report artifact)
palette dialog got its own labelled title (test caught shared accessible name)
cycles.validate: 4/4 green in real Chromium locally; YAML parsed

cycles.why: Buttons-only moves are not a kanban; dnd-kit is the 2026 standard (a11y-first, 1M dl/wk).
changes: @dnd-kit/react cards/columns, drop persists via PATCH, buttons kept as keyboard fallback
e2e drag test with real mouse path
